title: Corrective and Preventive Action Record
purpose: Document nonconformity, containment, causal analysis, corrective and preventive action, effectiveness, residual risk, and closure.

records.Guidance: Describe the indicator, incident, complaint, audit finding, accreditation gap, or threshold breach.
Record patient, workforce, data, service, and continuity protections, including restriction or pause.
Preserve data state, model and software version, output, human action, timing, workload, and context.
Identify confirmed and competing technical, clinical, workflow, organizational, and governance causes.
Define action, responsible owner, due date, revalidation, communication, and contract or vendor response.
Identify controls intended to prevent recurrence in this and related systems.
Define evidence, observation period, threshold, independent review, and residual uncertainty.
Record decision, date, dissent, residual risk, and next review.
